scope_of_work.work_description: Complete tear-off of existing BUR/gravel roof, deck inspection/repair (steel + wood sections), new TPO 60-mil fully-adhered single-ply system with R-30 polyiso insulation and cover board, new flashings at 47 penetrations, resolution of ponding via tapered insulation or added drains. Phased work required on occupied pharma-warehouse, max 15,000 sqft open at once.

membrane_system_specified.thickness_spec: 60 mil minimum, white (>=80% solar reflectance), heat-welded seams

included_items: Full tear-off and disposal to deck
Deck inspection and repair (steel); wood deck unit pricing
R-30 polyiso in two staggered layers
1/4 inch gypsum or HD polyiso cover board
Tapered insulation or added drains to resolve ponding
New flashings at 47 penetrations (HVAC, vents, skylights, drains)
Phasing plan (max 15,000 sqft exposed, watertight at EOD)
excluded_items: Asbestos/ACM abatement actual costs (owner-borne if discovered)
Steel deck structural repairs priced separately
alternates_requested: Insulation above code per R-value increment

extraction_notes: Classified as obc_part_3: 85,000 sqft industrial warehouse exceeds 600 m² threshold regardless of storeys.
Building built 1998 (post-1980) — DSA under OHSA s.30 not automatically required, but §2.3 cautions ACM/lead possible in transition-era materials; bidders directed to include safety protocols.

Warranty type not explicitly stated as NDL; defaulted to total_system_ndl per Part 3 convention (fixture 02 §1). RECOMMEND owner clarify in addendum — 'manufacturer warranty' without NDL language invites cheapest material-only coverage.
No bid bond percentage stated in §9.2 (only performance + L&M bonds). Owner may wish to add a bid bond requirement for a project of this size.

Deck replacement allowance (board-feet) not quantified — owner relies on bidder unit pricing. Risk: bidders with low unit prices may inflate consumed quantity; bidders with high unit prices carry a hidden premium. RECOMMEND owner set an allowance or cap.

Evaluation weighting mapped to schema: RFP §7 Price 35 / Materials 20 + Value Eng 3 → technical_approach 23 / Warranty 15 / Schedule 12 / References 10 / Safety 5 → qualifications_certifications 5. Totals 100.
